user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search results and features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and relevance of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits landing pages submitted as ads.
user_agents.opt_out: Not specified.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web content for generative AI foundation model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform user-initiated actions and interactions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: User-triggered requests and external application interactions via GPT Actions.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to potentially contribute to AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Crawls public web content across domains and subdomains for generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in the robots.txt file.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites to retrieve web content at users' direction.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot

user_agents.scope: Indexes and analyzes online content specifically to enhance user search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Claude-SearchBot in your robots.txt file.
